title.zh: DSH 办公·电网绘图套件

description.en: Read, edit and format Word/Excel; draw GB/T 4728 Visio grid diagrams (single-line, protection, terminal strip...); smart CAD-to-PDF conversion with frame split, title-block catalog and batch queue. Windows, MIT.
description.zh: Word/Excel 阅读编辑排版；GB/T 4728-2022 Visio 电网图（主接线/二次/端子排/地理接线/潮流图等）；CAD 转 PDF（图框自动分割、图签识别生成图纸目录表、批量队列）。Windows，MIT 开源。
